subject: windmill
scope: Independent visual comparison of source-keys.png, design.png, revisions/keys-v2.png and source.json only. Four still keys in chronological 2x2 order; no playback or between-key rotation approval.

evidence.observation: Source and drawing begin with a diagonal four-sail cross, including an upper-left sail and an upper-right sail. The drawing uses four broad polygonal sails with kinked roots and irregular tips, preserving the selected design's broad hand-drawn vocabulary.

Both crosses rotate toward the near-vertical/near-horizontal phase: the upper sail leans slightly left and the right sail rises slightly. All four drawing sails meet the same small hub on the tower cap.

The source upper sail has passed vertical toward the right, with the cross arm near horizontal; the drawing shows the same angular phase. Its four broad sails remain attached around the hub without an extra blade or detached segment.

Source and drawing return to a diagonal cross in the later phase. The drawing preserves the fixed tower and hub position within the framing foliage, with the same four broad sails rotated as a coherent assembly.

protected_strengths: Common fixed hub and plausible tower support
Source angular phases across all four keys
Source low-angle composition and surrounding tree framing
